abstract: A digital twin is defined as information representing the characteristics and behavior of an entity in order to replicate a physical entity in the digital world. However, problems such as the lack of a common definition and understanding of the digital twin and the provision of a standardized information model to enhance interoperability between data sources are still obstacles to the introduction of the digital twin. In this paper, in order to build a digital twin more easily, we are going to conduct a study on the design of a digital twin module that supports data synchronization between physical and digital entities and modeling of the characteristics and behaviors of entities.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Incomplete Regions Estimation and Restoration of 3D Human Face Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Incomplete regions in the 3D human face point cloud cause performance degradation in many applications such as human face recognition, classification, segmentation, upsampling, etc. Many methods have been studied to the completion of missing regions in different categories of datasets. However, it is a challenging task to estimate the incomplete regions in the 3D human face point cloud dataset owing to the complex shape and surface structure. In this article, we propose a novel approach to estimating and restoring 3D points in missing regions. First, we project the 3D points into a 2D depth map and use a deep learning model to estimate the missing parts. Then the complete 2D depth map is used to reconstruct the 3D point in incomplete regions. We also restore the estimated points using a deep learning model to improve the quality of the data. The proposed method assures better performance than the state-of-the-art methods in estimation and restoration of the 3D human face point cloud.

articleTitle: Towards Query Latency Optimization in the Fog
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The streaming data is increasing at an exceeding rate due to the proliferation of IoT (Internet of Things)-enabled applications. Many IoT applications demand fast analytics of streaming data for real-time responses. Thus, it is crucial to have an effective query optimization technique. The query optimization within fog is a challenging issue due to its heterogeneity and being a highly resource-constrained environment. In this paper, we propose a query optimization approach that optimally performs both the data approximation and query task execution in the fog to drastically reduce query latency with efficient resource utilization. We introduce a novel optimal fog node selection algorithm which performs the optimal set selection based on minimum-cost criteria while considering the current network conditions. Additionally, we present an efficient compute congestion-aware scheduling technique that performs task scheduling by taking into account the resource capacity of fog nodes. Our evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms other techniques in terms of latency and bandwidth consumption.

articleTitle: Comparative study in anomaly diagnosis technique for time series data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, by comparing the values of the anomaly index in various anomaly diagnosis techniques on the same dataset, it is intended to help in selecting an anomaly diagnosis technique suitable for the desired task. We compare the models from the commonly used CNN or LSTM-based autoencoder anomaly diagnosis technique to its variant model DAGMM (Deep Autoencoding Gaussian Mixture model), deep learning-based SVDD (Support Vector Data Description), and recently USAD (Unsupervised Anomaly Detection) with each other. Since the anomaly index value at the time of occurrence of anomalies varies depending on the model, it is possible to consider the model selection according to the data distribution through these index values.

articleTitle: An Oxide-TFT-based Inverter with Improved Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We investigated the output voltage characteristics of conventional NMOSFET inverter, bootstrap inverter, pseudo-CMOS inverter and proposed improved inverter. The simulation showed no voltage decreasing in output high and reduced offset voltage in output low. The voltage in output low of the proposed inverter decreased by 85, 84 and 50 % compared to the conventional inverter, bootstrap inverter, and pseudo-CMOS inverter, respectively.

articleTitle: 3D Synthetic Image Training and Testing Data for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose generating training and testing images for autonomous driving using the CARLA simulator. Several experiments have been performed to prove the effectiveness of training on synthetic data, including those on mixed datasets including both data generated from CARLA and real-world data. The result of such experiments showed that synthetic data generated using the CARLA simulator was effective as training and testing data for on-road object detection.

articleTitle: SAR Ship Detection with Deep Land Detection Networks and Land Masking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We propose a new Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) ship detection framework using deep learning that makes SAR land mask to improve SAR ship detection performance. To overcome the disadvantage of a small number of SAR dataset, the land detection networks take a large amount of small image patches as input and effectively learn land feature for detecting land mask. We then eliminate land using the detected land mask and apply artificial noise to preserve image distribution. With these schemes, SAR ship detector can concentrate on ship feature rather than land feature. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method outperforms baseline.

articleTitle: Secure UAV Communications with Transmit-array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a secure unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) communication system with transmit-array antenna. We aim to maximize the average secrecy rate by jointly optimizing the trajectory of the UAV, the phase shifters of the intelligent transmitting surface (ITS), and the transmit beamforming vector. To address the non-convexity of the formulated optimization problem, we apply an alternating optimization (AO) technique. Simulation results verify the proposed optimization method and demonstrate the improved secrecy rate with the transmit-array antenna.

articleTitle: Design of Magnetic Hall Sensor for Current Sensing in a Standard CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a magnetic Hall sensor for current sensing in a standard CMOS process, which that does not include any special fabrication process steps for the sensor implementation. Based on the measurement results for a previously fabricated sensor device, we employ a square-shaped Hall plate as a sensor device and design a novel bridge instrumentation amplifier with chopping and auto-zero functions. The prototype of the sensor is implemented in a standard 180 nm CMOS process with a die area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$450\mu m\times 450\mu m$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Countermeasure to Frequency Shift of Transmitter for Human Body Communication according to Battery Output Voltage Drop
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, an operating frequency shift of the HBC transmitter according to the battery output voltage decreases was analyzed, and an appropriate operating frequency configuration for the HBC transmitter to minimize performance degradation was proposed. The operating frequency shift was measured as 30ppm with the supply voltage range from 3.0V to 2.1V. A frequency calibration was applied to the HBC transmitter to satisfy the CDR lock range that was measured for five HBC receiver samples.

articleTitle: Semi-Supervised Learning using Sequential Data for Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Learning on mobile devices has various constraints unlike workstations or learning servers. The entire training dataset is not defined before training network since the dataset should be collected with online. Thus, it is not a problem of learning a well-classified dataset, but a problem of learning using the input of a real camera. In addition, the camera input has the characteristics of unlabeled data, so it is difficult to apply the traditional supervised learning technique. In this paper, we propose a method for using semi-supervised learning on a mobile device with sequential input. In order to verify the proposed method, we make our own dataset for classifying 5 human faces with sequential input. In the experimental section, we verified that the proposed method effectively selects images from a continuous data set and prevents overfitting.

articleTitle: Determinant of Quantization Step Size with Neural Networks for Amplify-Quantize-Forward Relay Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper deals with the method of determining the quantization step size in an amplify-quantize-forward (AQF) relay channel with quadrature amplitude modulation. We introduce an existing method for determining the quantization step size in the AQF relay channels and propose a method applying neural networks to solve the computational complexity problem of the conventional method. Simulation results confirm the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation for Wildlife Animal Recognition Using Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Many military facilities are located in the mountain and the forests, so the wildlife animals easily pass through the facilities. To prevent their invasion, military facilities developed an advanced surveillance system to detect wildlife animals, but the insufficient data for nighttime animals has been a challenging problem. To solve the issue, we design two methods to augment and utilize the training data for nighttime wildlife animals by using a style transfer. The first method is designed to transfer the daytime data to be a style of nighttime data, and the second method exchanges the style of nighttime data with that of daytime data. Through the experiments, we show the effectiveness of the two methods, analyzing the augmented training data.

articleTitle: A Variation-aware Advantage Actor-critic (A2C) Machine for Optimization of CML-to-CMOS (C2C) Circuit Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: To cope with increasing complexity and difficulty of circuit design, reinforcement learning based circuit optimization is under research for many applications. In this paper, a RL machine based on A2C algorithm is introduced for optimizing C2C circuit design. The machine includes variation-aware reward establishment based on Pelgrom's model which helps the machine to correctly approximate Monte-carlo simulation result with single simulation result. As a result, compared to the manual design, the skew, duty-cycle error (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu+3\sigma$</tex>) and total non-ideality is improved about 30%, 7%, and 15%, respectively.

articleTitle: GAN based Visible to Thermal Image Translation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The increasing demands of deep learning based solutions for security and surveillance applications has opened various new challenges in computer vision. Multimodal face recognition is one of the important tasks where face recognition may be required to be performed on infrared or thermal camera images in locations with low visibility and challenging lighting conditions. However, the data available for such modalities is not enough as compared to data available for visible light images. This paper presents a generative adversarial network (GAN) based solution to solve the problem of data scarcity. The closed loop GAN system CycleGAN is used to generate novel thermal images from visible light images. The results are very impressive and close to reality.

articleTitle: Cost Aggregation with Transformers for Sparse Correspondence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this work, we introduce a novel network, namely SuperCATs, which aims to find a correspondence field between visually similar images. SuperCATs stands on the shoulder of the recently proposed matching networks, SuperGlue and CATs, taking the merits of both for constructing an integrative framework. Specifically, given keypoints and corresponding descriptors, we first apply attentional aggregation consisting of self- and cross-graph neural network to obtain feature descriptors. Subsequently, we construct a cost volume using the descriptors, which then undergoes a tranformer aggregator for cost aggregation. With this approach, we manage to replace the hand-crafted module based on solving an optimal transport problem initially included in SuperGlue with a transformer well known for its global receptive fields, making our approach more robust to severe deformations. We conduct experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, and show that the proposed model is on par with SuperGlue for both indoor and outdoor scenes.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction of Battery EOL with Intermediate State Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) is well known as one of the methods of compressing deep learning models. It aims to train the student model so that the student model (compressed model) can imitate the output of the teacher model (original model). However, the output of the teacher model alone may not be sufficient to train the student model. To compensate for this, we propose a method called Intermediate-State Knowledge Distillation (ISKD). Unlike most of the knowledge distillation studies that have been conducted for computer vision tasks, the proposed method is applied to a time series model that predicts the life of a battery using NASA AMES dataset. As a result, our method reduced the error level of battery End-of-Life (EOL) cycle by up to 1.04% compared to the conventional distillation method. In addition, the number of parameters could be reduced and at the same time, there was an advantage in terms of latency.

articleTitle: Novel Biomarker Based on Hemispheric Differences in Brain Connectivity for Diagnosis of Depression
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Biomarkers using EEG could be used to detect and analyze various mental diseases. Many researchers are working on biomarkers that are mostly based on spectral analysis, resulting in poor reproducibility so restricted to being used in a clinical environment. In this study, we proposed new biomarker, a potential biomarker for MDD using resting state EEG and EEG connectivity algorithm. To develop new biomarker, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$PRED+CT$</tex> dataset consisting of 43 MDD patients and 73 healthy control was used. wPLI connectivity for the low alpha band was acquired from 60 EEG channels. An independent sample t-test was conducted, and only statistically significant connectivity (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$p < 0.001$</tex>) was selected among the connectivity. As a result, there was the biggest difference in connectivity between CPz and left hemisphere connectivity among MDD patients and healthy control. A decrease in connectivity between the central parietal region and frontal/temporal region located in the left hemisphere of MDD patients is also confirmed. New biomarker could be utilized in a diagnosis of MDD, and we expect it to be used in a clinical environment.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Towards Digital Twin Implementation of an Automatic Sorting Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a framework towards a digital twin implementation in a manufacturing setting. An automatic sorting machine, which consists of several modules that are used for sorting item of different colors, is considered in this study. Each module is controlled by its own microcontroller that communicates with a local computing server through a wireless LAN communication over UDP protocol. Node-RED running on a local server is used for processing acquired sensor data from the modules and for controlling their operating sequences. A 3D model, rendered inside Unity3D environment, is created as a digital representation of the machine, allowing user to interact with the system through a VR headset. The synchronization of data between the physical and virtual world is done using MQTT protocol via NETPIE2020 cloud platform. End-to-end system latency for sending data from physical to virtual world, and vice versa, is approximately 60 ms.

articleTitle: Contrastive Learning Aided Single Image Deblurring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Fast and high-quality image deblurring is essential for real-time applications on edge devices. Reduction of the solution space is important for the ill-posed deblurring task. Different from most existing deblurring networks that pull together a blurry image and a sharp image in the latent space, this paper proposes contrastive learning aided deblurring that also pushes a deblurred image apart from a blurry image for training the existing MIMO-UNet. The contrastive loss combined with the multi-scale content loss and frequency reconstruction loss helps the deblurring network pull together the anchor and positive pair while pushes the anchor apart from the negative pair. The proposed progressive negative sample scheme gradually increases the lower bound of the quality of negative samples to keep the contrastive loss decreasing. For the GoPro dataset, the proposed scheme improves the quality of MIMO-UNet while keep the low inference time (0.392 second on GPU 1080Ti) and number of parameters (6.8 M) of the network unchanged.

articleTitle: Grid-Tied Zeta Inverter for Household Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: A grid-tied zeta inverter has been proposed for household energy storage systems. Over the state of the art technique using the flyback inverters, the proposed inverter provides reliable and safe operation mode. It also improves the manufacturing cost of the system by reducing the circuit components. It facilitates the commercial use of the proposed inverter for household energy storage systems. Experimental results have been given to evaluate the performance of the proposed inverter.

articleTitle: VVC Based Rate Control Using SKIP CTU Predictor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Versatile Video Coding (VVC) enables high coding gain on 360-degree equiangular cubemap (EAC) projection format. Nevertheless, the R-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}$</tex> model based rate control of VTM cannot accurately estimate <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}$</tex> of SKIP CTUs so that the bitrate error is increased. Thus this paper proposes a SKIP CTU predictor for VVC interframe rate control. Different from the existing SKIP block ratio based rate control scheme, the predictor runs before encoding the current CTU. It predicts whether the current CTU has high percentage of SKIP CUs or not instead of predicting whether the optimal mode of a CU is SKIP mode or not. The value of CTU-level <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}$</tex> of the predicted SKIP CTU is estimated using <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}$</tex> values in spatially adjacent CTUs to decrease the bitrate error. The lightweight neural network based predictor has only 199 parameters. Bit starvation in later coded frames is reduced by constraining frame-level quantization parameters in intra frames. Tests show that the proposed scheme outperforms state-of-the-art rate control methods on 360-degree 8K and 6K EAC videos on bitrate accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Facility Drain Inspection using Class Balancing with Synthesized Image Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: While aging facilities are rapidly increasing, there is a problem that safety management is disrupted due to insufficient manpower and time required for facility inspection. Currently, research on the development of a system that inspects facilities based on deep learning algorithms is increasing. In this paper, we propose an object-detection based inspection algorithm for gravity and siphonic drains on the roof of industrial complexes. It is difficult to find appropriate abnormal class samples for training. Therefore, a problem of class imbalance arises between normal and abnormal samples. To solve this problem, we generate abnormal class synthetically using image in-painting technique. The results show the effectiveness of approach used in this project.

articleTitle: Event Driven Communication of BLE composite Sensors for Monitoring Temperature of Hot Press Forming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an event driven communication method of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) composite sensors for energy saving. The aim of the composite sensor is to monitor the temperatures only while the hot press is forming. The composite sensor consists of an acceleration sensor and several temperature sensors. The acceleration sensor is to detect the forming start time and then the temperature sensor measures the forming temperature. This paper discusses the event detection method of the composite sensor and analyzes the expected battery lifetime.

articleTitle: Anomaly Segmentation Using Class-aware Erosion and Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Typical semantic segmentation methods focus on classification at the pixel level only for the classes included in the training dataset. However, they tend to fail to classify an unexpected class not included in the train dataset. Recent approaches compare the input and its resynthesized images to handle this problem but cannot accurately localize anomalous objects. In this paper, we propose feeding more precise uncertainty estimation to the dissimilarity module for anomaly predictions. Our approach achieved 61.19% AP and 30.77% FPR95 on Fishyscapes Lost and Found dataset.

articleTitle: Intelligent Surface-aided Transmit-array Antenna in mmWave Communication System with Historical Channel Observation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we study an intelligent surface-aided transmit-array antenna architecture which deploys intelligent transmitting surface (ITS) near the active antenna in mmWave downlink communication system. We aim to maximize the average achievable rate at the user by optimizing the phase shift matrix of ITS. To overcome the difficulty of acquiring channel state information (CSI), we propose a stochastic gradient descent (SGD)-based algorithm that requires only historical channel observations. Simulation results show that our proposed scheme with single active antenna and ITS outperforms conventional MISO system.

articleTitle: Monitoring System for Efficient ESS Charging/Discharging Scheduling based on Intelligent IoT Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In the case of charging/discharging of the existing Energy Storage System (ESS), since the time is predetermined, the optimal time zone that changes depending on the external environment and characteristics of the building cannot be applied, resulting in wasted energy. In this study, we construct a database (DB) by collecting internal and external environmental data and real-time space usage data through IoT for building and analyze the patterns of power peak times. In addition, in order to efficiently use the energy stored in the ESS, charging is performed at a time when power usage is low, discharging is performed at a time when power usage is rapidly increased, and it is visually managed through a monitoring system. Through this, it is expected that energy efficiency may be increased, energy independence rate may be increased, and ultimately carbon reduction and carbon neutrality may be achieved by reducing the amount of wasted power.

articleTitle: Deblurring Network for Accurate Facial Landmark Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We present a face image deblurring framework for accurate facial landmark detection. In face recognition application, performance is strongly affected by the detection accuracy of facial landmarks. Therefore, when developing a facial image deblurring algorithm, it is important not only to improve the restored image quality, but also to improve the landmark detection accuracy of structural parts of the face. In this work, we propose a simple but efficient deblurring network using Wavelet loss and Landmark-error related losses. Experimental results show that the proposed network has superior objective/subjective performance compared to the existing methods.

articleTitle: Dual-Navigator Travel Route Plan Method Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: When multiple navigators on the market each provide different types of services, they need to determine how to provide route planning by analysing the strategies of other navigators. Based on the idea of game theory, this paper studies the problem of user path allocation in the case of dual navigators. The navigator plans the route suitable for its own users by calculating the best response of the other navigator. The numerical analysis results show that the route allocation method obtained is in line with the needs of target users of each navigator.

articleTitle: Automatic Method of Camera Calibration for The Traffic Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This work solves the camera calibration problem in the surveillance scenario. We recommend a method to calibrate the camera automatically. We are easily implemented in any surveillance camera system. Our approach consists of three steps. In the first step, we extract the edges of the objects in the image frames. Step two applies the Hough transform algorithm to interpolate the line. Step three take two vanishing points and calibrate the camera. Our proposal is a new method to obtain the internal and external parameters of the camera, which can automatically calibrate the camera with high reliability.

articleTitle: Ubiquitous Multimodal Seizure Management Using Emerging Consumer Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Seizures are a significant public health concern which impact the quality of life for millions of individuals worldwide. Although dedicated consumer-grade technologies for assisting in seizure management exist, they are unsuitable for detecting all types of seizures due to their strong heterogeneity in presentation. This manuscript proposes a novel multimodal seizure management solution using emerging wearable computing technology. By fusing signals with known efficacy for seizure detection, including eye movement and motion signals, this approach offers a modular solution for supporting seizure sufferers with no additional hardware requirements. The system also offers additional value-added applications beyond seizure detection, including automated data logging and programmable notifications for caregivers.

articleTitle: Accuracy Comparison of Bluetooth Low Energy Indoor Positioning System based on measurement techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the localization performance of indoor positioning techniques based on measurement techniques; the angle of arrival-based (AOA) and the received signal strength-based (RSS). We employed the Texas Instruments (TI) CC26X2R LaunchPad which operated in IEEE 802.15.1 standards. Four patterns of the anchor placement were assigned to evaluate the location accuracy performance of both indoor positioning systems. The results show that AOA-based can achieve higher location accuracy performance than the RSS-based. In particular, the accuracy performance of the RSS-based will depend on anchor placement while the AOA-based does not affect significantly. However, the AOA-based anchors are limited by proprietary protocols due to undefined continuous tone extension (CTE) implementation in BLE 5.1 standard. They can only communicate with tags that are from the same vendor. In contrast, the RSS-based anchors can work with any tags that follow the BLE 4.2 standard.

articleTitle: Large-Area GaN FET Modeling Using Operating Temperature Distribution Characteristics of Gate Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the large-area GaN FET modeling using operating temperature distribution characteristics of gate channels of large-area GaN FET by an infrared microthermal measurement system. This method is one of candidates to overcome various limitations in large-area GaN FET modeling. The DC and RF power characteristic accuracies of the improved model compared the existing model of WINSEMI0.45 µm GaN FETwith 10-fingerand 4 mm gate width are more than 98% at DC of 0~40 V and RF power of 3.7 GHz.

articleTitle: Standardization Trends in CNN-Based In-Loop Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Inspired by the recent success of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in image restoration and artifact removal, CNN-based in-loop filters are actively developed in video compression standardization. This paper presents standardization trends of video coding, especially focusing on the techniques presented in the latest JVET-AA standard meeting.

articleTitle: Pointwise Quantization Method for Improving Lifting Transform of G-PCC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a pointwise quantization method that considers the reference characteristics of the G-PCC Lifting Transform is proposed. Depending on the level of detail of the Lifting Transform, the number of times each point is referenced in the prediction varies significantly. Reflecting these characteristics, we propose a method of allocating a proper quantization rate for each point according to influence of each point. Moreover, we also propose a rate-distortion optimized quantization for adaptive lambda values according to the influence of each point. The proposed method was implemented and evaluated on TMC13v14.0, the reference software of G-PCC. The proposed method achieves on average 0.7% YCbCr BD-rate gain under C1 condition.

articleTitle: A VFSM-based Virtual Platform Verification Methodology for Early Firmware Development of Solid-State Drive
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Virtual platform (VP) has been used for early software (SW) development to shorten the product release period. Since SW is implemented using virtual hardware (HW) models, which is not real one, the verification methodology is extremely important in order to keep the consistency between them, i.e., the virtual HW and the real one. In this paper, a VP verification methodology based on a virtual finite-state machine (VFSM) is proposed for early firmware (FW) development of solid-state drive (SSD) product. The proposed method reduces the verification cost compared to existing methods. Thus, it contributes securing the consistency of SSD VP, following up achieving the stability of SSD product through shift-lefting the FW development.

articleTitle: Displacement Detection of Wooden Cultural Properties Using Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Since supervised learning requires expert labeling work that requires a lot of time and money to acquire data, an alternative is required in the field of cultural property management. In addition, the existing method based on contact type sensors to detect displacement occurring in wooden cultural heritage has a risk of damage to cultural heritage. This paper proposes to apply an artificial intelligence model using f-AnoGAN, which shows good performance in detecting abnormalies, to overcome the difficulty of obtaining abnormal data in wooden cultural assets with an unsupervised learning approach and to explore alternatives to the conventional contact type sensor-based method. The applied anomaly detection model, f-AnoGAN, is characterized by the fact that learning is performed to simultaneously minimize the error in the image space and the error in the feature space when a new image is mapped to the latent space and then returned to the image space. Our experimental results show that the f-AnoGAN model successfully performs judgment on whether or not displacement has occurred in wooden cultural properties using actual CCTV color images, and further presents the location of displacement when displacement occurs.

articleTitle: Applying Bilateral Guided Multi-Viewed Fusion on Asymmetrical 3D Convolution Networks for 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We present a novel approach for 3D semantic segmentation using LiDAR sensor. In this work, we focus on improving the accuracy of the cylindrical partition and asymmetrical 3D convolution networks with a modification on their dimension-decomposition based context modeling module and asymmetrical residual block. The initial version simply performs multiplication and addition operators to combine two feature branches. In our modification, we apply the bilateral guided multi-viewed fusion module to provide better features for the classification stages. We trained and tested our model on SemanticKITTI dataset, our implementation improves better accuracy than the default asymmetrical 3D convolution networks, in which uses cylindrical voxel for the point cloud representation.

articleTitle: Comparing Regression Models Predicting the Price of Used Cars in Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We built and compared regression models to find the optimal solution using Spark Big Data engine, which predicts the price of used cars. We have the Cargurus dataset to perform predictive analysis, which is consumer data set as of 9.29 GB. The traditional systems have difficulty to handle the large scale data greater than hundreds of Mega-Bytes. Our Spark cluster can resolve this issue by storing and training the models with the large-scale data as distributed parallel computing systems. We adopt multiple regression algorithms to train models using Spark library in the big data environment. Then, we compare the models by measuring the computing time and accuracy. We observed that the GBT model shows the best accuracy in RMSE and R2 but relatively long computation time. The Random Forest model has a similar RMSE and R2 as GBT but with less computing time.

articleTitle: Voice Monitoring System for Vocal Dose Measurement in Daily Life
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: An accumulation of vocal fatigue due to excessive vocalization causes diseases such as vocal cord nodules and polyps. Continuous observation of the voice condition is known to prevent the diseases. However, a normal microphone for voice measurement has the fatal drawback of recording ambient noise simultaneously. In this paper, we introduce a neck-attached voice monitoring sensor. The sensor measures the vibration of contacted area, so it is robust against ambient noise. In addition, a random noise was effectively removed through an embedded adaptive filter. As a result, the sensor can continuously measure voice signals in daily life without ambient noise. Also, vocal fatigue can be quantified through fundamental frequency and intensity analysis of measured voice.

articleTitle: EEG-based Mental Workload Estimation using Encoder-Decoder Networks with Multilevel Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a model that combines the multilevel feature fusion algorithm and encoder-decoder structure for evaluation of mental workload using electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. The encoder-decoder structure was used to reduce additive noise and subject variations of EEG data. The encoder is structured by incorporating a 3D convolutional neural network (3DCNN) and multilevel feature fusion concept, which extracts unified key features from combining the low-level and high-level features. The decoder consists of simple 3DCNN layers to recover the input EEG image from the latent vector. The proposed model can achieve higher performance by mitigating feature variations. We evaluate our network with EEG data obtained through the Sternberg task to estimate mental workload, which has 91.6% accuracy and outperforms the conventional algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Temperature Control Scheduling Method for Improving Energy Efficiency in Building Space
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Home Internet of Things (IoT) technology is the most popular field among IoT convergence services. Beyond the limitations of existing home network technology, home appliances and home facilities that include IoT functions produce information on their own, connect with other objects or people, and make a certain level of automation decisions to improve the quality of users' residential life services. Currently, intelligent IoT is combined in the living space, and it is drawing attention to expand the living world by smartly filling convenience in life by analyzing residents' patterns and creating a customized environment or automatically executing it. To achieve 2050 carbon neutrality, this paper uses artificial intelligence technology to manage energy in buildings more efficiently and further optimally control intelligent IoT devices to present a scheduling method that can control smart home energy for users.

articleTitle: Design of Ka-band 10W high power amplifier based on GaN on Si process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This study presents the design of power amplifier (PA) in 100 nm GaN HEMT technology. A customized transistor model enables the designing circuits operating at Ka-band. The all matching network of the PA was composed of equivalent transformer circuit to reduce matching loss. And then, equivalent transformer is several advantages without any additional inductive devices so that a wideband power characteristic can be achieved. The designed die area is 4, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$360\text{um}\times 4,330\ \text{um}$</tex>. The designed results at center frequency achieved the small signal gain of 22.9 dB, the saturated output power (Psat) of 41 dBm, and the power added efficiency (PAE) of 34.3% at the supply voltage of 12V.

articleTitle: Half-Instance Normalization for Accurate Object Detection in Hazy Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Deep learning models are designed to work in ideal image conditions. Hazy conditions are frequent in drone images. Hence, insufficient lighting and low visibility during image capture significantly degrade the performance of object detection models. Recently, Instance Normalization has been applied in low-level image restoration tasks such as de-raining, de-snowing, dehazing, etc., with significant improvement in the enhancement effect. Inspired by this, a Half-Instance Normalization network (HINet) is proposed as a preprocessing network to assist object detection models by removing hazy regions and enhancing the features of objects. The HINet is trained end-to-end using the A2I2-Haze dataset consisting of hazy and clear image pairs accompanied by bounding box annotations. Additionally, Scaled-YOLOv4 models are trained with a bag of tricks that give further improvements. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the appealing effects of image restoration in increasing the accuracy of object detection tasks.

articleTitle: Skin Color Information Extraction using a Cylindrical Reflection Sensor for Glycated Hemoglobin Estimation using PPG signals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) is an important measure that should be monitored in daily life for the measurement and management of diabetes. Since the HbAl c reflects the average blood glucose level of about 3 months, it is possible to effectively monitor the blood glucose level of diabetic patients. In addition, a noninvasive HbAl c estimation method using the PPG signal has been the subject of recent research, and this method can enable convenient health management without the pain of blood collection and the risk of infection. Several methods have been proposed to noninvasively estimate HbA1c, but they do not secure sufficient accuracy. In order to overcome this, it is urgent to find a method to improve the accuracy by considering skin color and skin thickness. In this paper, we propose a method for extracting skin color information using a cylindrical object, and through this, we suggest the possibility of performance improvement by considering skin effect in a noninvasive HbAl c estimation.

articleTitle: Design of Safety Guidance System for Rehabilitation Exercise Program
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Rehabilitation exercise should be performed in a safe way within proper range of movements. In this paper, we suggest safety guidance system for rehabilitation exercise program. The system provides individualized experience for the same content depending on the patient's health conditions. The system analyzes a patient's exercise movements using pose detection model to guarantee the safe rehabilitation exercise.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method to Improve the Performance of Small-Scale Convolutional Neural Networks by Hybrid Selective Initial Parameter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Transfer learning (TL) is a method used in various fields of convolutional neural networks (CNN) based applications. TL provide the opportunity for CNN, able to learn with limited datasets. A generally used TL involves pre-trained model from large-scale datasets. Pre-trained model help prevent the restriction of performance from learn with limited datasets. There are many experiments on limited datasets, but few that assume small CNN models together. Limited-resources, which involves small-scale CNN and limited datasets, can have different learning tendency compare to the large-scale CNN. This paper proposes an efficient method that could achieve better performance using hybrid selection which based on the channel importance calculated from experimental results of limited resources. With a 38% reduction training time, proposed model achieve an accuracy of 12.33% higher than randomly-initialized model. And achieve a 10% reduction training time with 1.2% accuracy increment compare to the TL model.

articleTitle: Variation-Tolerant Capacitive Coupling Sense Amplifier with Body Biasing Technique for High-Performance SRAM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the SRAM sense amplifier (SA) that can improve read speed by making it tolerant to process variation. By using the body biasing effect, the proposed body bias variation tolerant small-signal sense amplifier (BB-VTS-SA) decreased the standard deviation of offset voltage by 12.4% compared to the original variation tolerant small-signal sense amplifier (VTS-SA).

articleTitle: CMOS Reference Voltage Source Using Drain Current Temperature Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a CMOS reference voltage source that is insensitive to changes in power supply and temperature, targeted for consumer electronics applications where low cost is mandatory. The proposed reference voltage source consists of diode-connected MOSFETs in series and the bias current generator with the Nagata current source insensitive to temperature as well as supply voltage. This circuit utilizes the drain current temperature characteristics for the temperature insensitivity realization. The basic circuit design idea, circuit topology and SPICE simulation results with TSMC <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.18\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> CMOS parameters are shown. Also, its application to the reference voltage distribution on the entire chip is discussed.

articleTitle: ASB-AM/OFDMA with FSS and TPC for Reducing Packet Overhead
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Recently, orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) has been used as a multiple access method. OFDMA with adaptive modulation can provide superior system performance. However feedback information (FBI) is needed at the transmitter side to efficiently allocate subcarriers to users and to control the modulation level of each subcarrier. Since FBI is a packet overhead, it must be reduced to mitigate the system complexity. FBI consists of channel state information (CSI) and SNR information. Therefore, in an AM-OFDMA system, a large amount of control information is required to achieve high frequency utilization efficiency and high data rates. Furthermore at the receiver side, modulation level information (MLI) is also needed to demodulate the received packets. Since MLIs are transmitted as data symbols, throughput degradation is a problem in AM-OFDMA systems, where MLIs are required on every subcarrier. To reduce FBI and MLI as a packet overhead, in this paper, we propose an adaptive subcarrier block assignment for AM-OFDMA with FSS and TPC.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Graph Construction Methods for Survival Prediction using Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Survival analysis from whole slide histopathology images (WSIs) is challenging due to the high dimensionality of WSIs. Graph-based approaches thus have been extensively studied to analyze WSIs. Recent success of graph neural networks further promotes graph-based approaches for survival analysis. However, the performance of graph-based methods is heavily dependent on graph construction methods. In this paper, we compare and analyze different graph construction methods for survival prediction from WSIs on the TCGA bladder and brain cancer pathology image datasets

articleTitle: High-speed gate-mode single photon detection module using dual anode single photon avalanche diode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: High-speed gate mode single-photon detectors based on single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) commonly suffer from the after-pulsing and dark noises es. In this article, a compact, low-noise single-photon detector useful for commercial quantum cryptography systems, which can detect weak avalanche signals by using InGaAs/InP dual anode SPADs (DA-SPADs), is introduced. The single-photon detection efficiency of 25 % is achieved with the dark count probability of 4.2 x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>/gate and the after-pulsing probability of 3.9 % at 1 GHz gating frequency and −5 °C SPAD temperature. A few more useful test results with higher temperature are also introduced.

Author Keywords: dual anode single photon avalanche diode

articleTitle: Feature Variance Loss: A Loss Function for Semantic Segmentation using Feature Space Distance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Semantic segmentation is a task that classifies all pixels in an image. In terms of the classification task, the segmentation network uses convolutional neural network(CNN) to extract the feature vectors of all pixels and infer which class they are. Pixels that correspond to the same class from the perspective of contrastive learning should have similar feature vectors extracted. Using the assumption that similar feature vectors should be extracted in the same class, we propose a Feature Variation(FV) loss function that induces the corresponding feature vectors of the same class to have similar values. This FV loss induces features extracted from the same class to be located closely in the feature embedding space. The proposed FV loss can be applied model-agnostic by adding it to the existing segmentation network. As demonstrated in the paper, the proposed FV loss improves the performance of the segmentation by inducing the feature vector of the same class to be closer.

articleTitle: Multilevel Feature Fusion-based Convolutional Neural Network for Anomaly Classification of Respiratory Sound
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Respiratory sound classification has been extensively studied to early detect heart and lung diseases using digital stethoscope. Previous works mainly leveraged convolutional neural network (CNN)-based deep learning methods by transforming sound signals into spectrogram images. The fine-tuned model based on pretrained ResNet (RespireNet) has been proposed and achieved high performance. However, ResNet has a very large network size, which is not suitable for mobile applications. In this paper, we proposed a lightweight deep learning approach based on a CNN architecture by incorporating self-attention and multilevel feature extraction. With considerably fewer number of parameters, we achieved a competitive performance compared to the state-of-the-art model, RespireNet, on the ICBHI dataset for normal-abnormal respiratory sound classification. The smaller model size can give an advantage in the development of internet of things (IoT) applications for automatic respiratory sound classification.

articleTitle: Enhanced Interval Oscillator Training in Mobile DRAM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Recently, as the operating speed of mobile DRAM increases, the process of reliable transmission (Tx) and reception (Rx) between the DRAM and the controller, which is known as the training, becomes very important. In addition, the re-training is an important process that can compensate for the training delay variation caused by process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variation that occurs frequently during mobile DRAM operation. In this paper, we propose the enhanced interval oscillator training method using time-digital convertor (TDC) for more accurate re-training than the conventional interval oscillator training.

articleTitle: Effective Playback Scheme of Targeted Advertisement Contents Exploiting Digital Cueing Signal over IPTV Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the effective playback scheme of targeted AD (ADvertisement) contents exploiting digital cueing signal over IPTV (Internet Protocol TeleVision) service. In the proposed scheme, the digital cueing signal multiplexed with the watching live IPTV program contents enables a STB (Set-Top Box) device to identify AD playback section accurately. For eliminating playback delay of pre-downloaded AD contents during AD playback section, a STB device then adjusts their MPEG (Moving Picture Experts Group)-2 TS (Transport Stream) attributes of pre-downloaded AD contents. Test results demonstrate that the proposed scheme works greatly over commercial IPTV network.

articleTitle: Image Compression with Channel-wise Decoder
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an image compression scheme which uses a channel-wise decoder in the decoding network. The proposed method uses a wavelet based auto-encoder with multiple decoders where each decoder is responsible for each channel in the color image, i.e., the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R,\ G$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$B$</tex> channels. The separated channel-wise decoders result in a better reconstructed color image than a single decoder and therefore also in a better compression rate.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Target Following and Obstacle Avoidance Methods in Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this study, we develop a companion robot function that can recognize people and obstacles, and track the human target while avoiding the obstacles. In implementing the JetBot tracking function, a deep learning-based object detection model is modified and utilized. A transfer learning algorithm with a pretrained mobile model is introduced for a feasible operation in the proposed framework with mobile robots.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Code Selective Histogram Algorithm For ADC Linearity Test
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper evaluates our previously proposed code selective histogram method with multi-tone input signal for the short-time accurate linearity testing of the ADC in consumer electronic products. Our code selective histogram method with two-tone sine wave for the SAR ADC test is taken up as an example and evaluated precisely, to test the linearity for specific vulnerable codes. Using only one harmonic component is a good point of two-tone sine wave input method. We have derived an explicit algorithm to obtain DNL and INL from the histogram data with multi-tone input. Then we have developed a program to validate our algorithm, and our simulation results show that the effectiveness and performance of the code selective histogram method.
